title: Venezuelan Beef Empanadas
description: A delicious and crispy empanada filled with ground beef, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: In a large pan, heat coconut oil over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until onion is translucent.
Add ground beef, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Cook until beef is browned.
In a separate bowl, whisk eggs.
Roll out empanada dough and use a cookie cutter to create shapes.
Place a spoonful of beef mixture onto the center of each dough shape.
Brush edges with eggs and fold dough in half to form a triangle.
Grill empanadas for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
